scope: Evidence-only audit of the historical fulltrack Q3 canonical evaluation and its training provenance. Historical artifacts are immutable.

historical_metrics.protocol: MusicCaps 5521; MeanFlow 25; CFG 0; seed 42; NoMask; full precision

concurrent_state.disposition: Concurrent external correction preserved; this audit makes no authorship claim.

metric_pattern.interpretation: Descriptive association only; it does not establish causality or human preference.

findings.claim: Stale-audio contamination explains this historical evaluation run.
evidence: The frozen eval log contains exactly one Eval args record, 5521 Audio saved records, and 5521 unique saved FLAC paths.
limitations: This refutes the specific stale-file explanation for this run; it does not prove byte-level reproducibility.

findings.claim: The historical evaluation is reproduced at byte level.
evidence: The historical report and aggregate metrics remain available.
limitations: Generated audio was deleted and no per-audio hash manifest was preserved.

findings.claim: The historical caption2p0/slot012 contract identity was a provenance mislabel and the current contract now records the correction.
evidence: The bound checkpoint training log uses phase8_qwen_meansim_k3_balanced.tsv: a Q-conditioned upstream track-level caption corpus, distinct from the per-segment Caption 2.0 slot0 Q3 checkpoint.
The current contract identifies phase8-fulltrack-q3-full-cfg0-eval, names the fulltrack q-bucket selection, and preserves the historical run identifiers only as identifiers.
limitations: The historical metric vector itself is retained unchanged; this audit makes no authorship claim for the concurrent correction.

findings.claim: The fulltrack corpus has a track-to-10-second caption granularity mismatch.
evidence: One upstream track caption was broadcast to retained segments while each training row represents the segment's first approximately 10 seconds.
limitations: Granularity mismatch is not cross-track mismatch.

findings.claim: Available evidence proves that captions crossed between different tracks.
evidence: The mapper keys the upstream caption by the same local track identity before broadcasting it to that track's segments.
limitations: Historical row-level NPZ binding remains separately inconclusive.

findings.claim: The historical TSV-to-NPZ text binding was correct for every training row.
evidence: The run used require_text_overlay=false; the original NPZ directory was later overwritten in place.
limitations: The original cache is unavailable, so current files can neither prove nor disprove the historical binding.

findings.claim: The Q pathway was unused or the Q3 result came from random, uninitialized quality embeddings.
evidence: The MeanFlow runner passes q_level when use_q_conditioning=true; the migration record proves q0 through q9 were initialized as bit-exact copies of trained q10 before Stage 2.
limitations: This does not prove Q caused the metric gain.

findings.claim: Same-track caption sharing alone is sufficient to produce the PQ gain.
evidence: The R-Shared quarter control reduced CLAP from 0.1916 to 0.1703 and PQ changed from 6.3911 to 6.3836 rather than increasing.
limitations: That control used rich local captions, NoQ, quarter scale, and an older MF1 evaluation, so interactions remain unresolved.

findings.claim: The table is consistent with an aesthetic-versus-prompt-adherence tradeoff and possible optimization toward a no-reference aesthetic predictor.
evidence: After deduplicating repeated exp_label rows, Pearson correlations with PQ are CE 0.969184, CU 0.987095, PC 0.459229, and CLAP -0.126996; Worst arms repeatedly have lower CLAP and higher PQ than Best arms.
Audiobox Aesthetics defines CE, CU, PC, and PQ as independent no-reference per-item axes, not prompt-alignment metrics.
limitations: Correlation and model scores do not establish causality, human preference, or metric gaming.

findings.claim: Fulltrack Q3 is a reproducible causal advantage that should be adopted.
evidence: The historical canonical metric is unusually high and is useful for hypothesis generation.
limitations: Training provenance is not reproducible, the mechanism is unresolved, and no matched fresh training replication exists.

bounded_conclusion: An evaluation bug is not demonstrated. A contract-label provenance defect and track-to-10-second granularity mismatch are confirmed; historical row-level binding and the causal mechanism remain unresolved. PQ 6.9337 is hypothesis evidence, not a reproducible causal advantage.
next_experiment_requirements: Fresh-directory, no-skip canonical repeats of fulltrack Q3 q9 and per-segment slot0 Q3 q9.
A canonical CFG0 evaluation of the historical fulltrack NoQ checkpoint.
A fulltrack Q3 q0 diagnostic explicitly labeled secondary and noncanonical.
Checkpoint, TSV, argv, code, environment, ID-to-audio SHA256, metric-count, report, and cleanup manifests must be immutable and fail closed.
Any causal claim requires a freshly bound and reproducible training control; evaluation-only evidence is insufficient.
